title: Nonnegativity of the expectation of a nonnegative function
statement: Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function that is nonnegative at every point, so $f(x) \ge 0$ for all $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then its expectation under the uniform measure is nonnegative: $\E[f] \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: f is pointwise nonnegative on the Boolean hypercube
